project.name: Primitive
release_notes: Owned TimeMatch appointments and calendar invitations carry the organizer-supplied physical destination or HTTPS video-call link.
The shared provider-independent venue fact validates address and call-link input. Exact owned-event readback refuses a changed destination, while updates preserve unrelated user notes and reminders.
Availability discovery remains busy/free only; location and join-link fields are written or read only for the specifically owned appointment.
